title: Example Course
subtitle: A working course that teaches the course format by being one

lessons.title: 3. Packaging and Sharing
lessons.outline:
## Coming next

This lesson is deliberately left unwritten, so you can see what a stub looks like in the sidebar and in the progress count.

It would cover:

- `scripts/package-course.sh` and what ends up in the zip
- Dropping a downloaded course into `courses/`
- Why progress is keyed on `slug`, and what happens when two courses collide

Mark a lesson `"stub": true` in `manifest.json` and give it an `outline` like this one. It will not count against the progress bar.
